# muxt explore-module in a route_paths module does not list the hub directory
# as a package, and shows each package's route paths type as the hub's.

muxt generate
muxt explore-module
! stdout 'generate route_paths'
! stdout '(?m)^Package: example\.com/m$'
stdout 'example.com/m/admin'
stdout 'example.com/m/blog'
stdout 'Route Paths Type: +m\.Paths'
! stdout 'Route Paths Type: +TemplateRoutePaths'

muxt explore-module --format=json
! stdout '"path": ?"example.com/m"'
stdout '"templateRoutePathsType": ?"m\.Paths"'

muxt generate-fake-server admin
exists cmd/explore-goland/main.go
exists cmd/explore-goland/internal/fake/receiver.go
exec go build ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.24
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {
		"output_paths_type": "Paths"
	},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /admin Dashboard()").Parse(`<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle 42}}">article</a>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() string { return "dashboard" }
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import "html/template"

var templates = template.Must(template.New("GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)").Parse(`<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>`))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
